about: I am a researcher and doctoral scholar at AcSIR–CSIR-CEERI, Pilani, exploring multimodal AI, industrial assembly understanding, human–robot interaction, and efficient language models.

My perspective combines more than a decade of professional work across India, Saudi Arabia, and the United Arab Emirates in IT and cybersecurity with hands-on work on multimodal datasets, action understanding, and industrial intelligence.
